context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

We added a transform processor that drops resource attributes to reduce cardinality, and now our APM counters are no longer monotonic — they reset randomly. We dropped service.instance.id, host.name, and k8s.pod.uid. Which one needs to come back to fix the single-writer violation?

checklist.name: recommends-restoring-service-instance-id-as-t
checklist.description: Recommends restoring service.instance.id as the unique-writer identity. FAIL only if it suggests stripping more attributes instead of restoring one, or if it picks a non-identity attribute (e.g. service.version) as the fix.
